```lean
intro a b h ha hb
cases h with c d
have h1 : a * b = 12 := h
have h2 : a > b := ha
have h3 : b > 2 := hb
have h4 : b ≥ 3 := le_of_gt h3
have h5 : a ≥ b + 1 := le_of_gt h2
have h6 : a ≥ 4 := lt_trans (lt_add_right zero_lt_one h2) (le_refl 4)
have h7 : b ≤ 12 / a := mul_le_mul_left h5 (le_refl 12)
have h8 : b ≤ 3 := le_trans h7 (div_le_div_right h6 (le_refl 12))
have h9 : b = 3 := eq_of_le_antisymm h4 h8
subst h9
have h10 : a * 3 = 12 := h1
have h11 : a = 4 := eq_of_mul_left_inj (ne_of_gt h2) h10
exact h11
```
